subject: Suppress node labels in BSM plots?

messages.author: 77157785e2f788ce
messages.subject: Suppress node labels in BSM plots?
parts:
Hi Nick, 

I am generating BSMs for a very large tree. Because the branch colors in BSM plots already show the reconstructed states I would like to suppress these node labels to reduce clutter. I looked at the plotwhat parameter but there seems to be only two options (i.e. "text" and "pie") and none to suppress node labels altogether. 

Is there a way to suppress node labels in BSM plots? Alternatively, is there a way to plot BSM output using e.g. plot.phylo and nodelabels commands from ape that allow for more customization? 

Thanks! 

Robin

messages.author: 115d05260b0c341a
messages.subject: Re: [BioGeoBEARS] Suppress node labels in BSM plots?
parts:
Hi Robin!  Your best best is to look at the code of the BioGeoBEARS plot functions for BSMs, they are just wrappers that use APE functions like nodelabels().  So, all you would have to do would be to copy that code, rename the function, and comment-out the line using nodelabels (or something like that).

You can get the code by typing the name of the function (without parentheses) into the R terminal, or by looking at the files used in the source() command on the PhyloWiki page.

Cheers!

Nick
